title: Provision Nutanix AHV VM from Pre-Hardened Template
description: Provisions a Nutanix AHV VM by cloning an approved pre-hardened template, configuring CPU/RAM/NIC/guest customization, creating the disk layout, initializing the OS (Windows Server 2025 or RHEL 10), and capturing a pre-CIS hardening checkpoint with provisioning evidence.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: nutanix_host
parameters.description: Prism Central hostname or IP address.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates for Prism Central API calls.

parameters.name: template_vm_name
parameters.description: Name of the approved pre-hardened template VM to clone.

parameters.name: new_vm_name
parameters.description: Name to assign to the newly provisioned VM.

parameters.name: cpu_sockets
parameters.description: Number of vCPU sockets for the new VM.

parameters.name: cpu_cores_per_socket
parameters.description: Number of cores per socket for the new VM.

parameters.name: cpu_threads_per_core
parameters.description: Number of threads per core for the new VM.

parameters.name: memory_gb
parameters.description: Memory size in GB for the new VM.

parameters.name: provisioning_port_group_name
parameters.description: Name of the temporary provisioning port group (subnet) to attach the vNIC to.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Hostname to configure on the new VM via guest customization.

parameters.name: os_disk_gb
parameters.description: Size of the OS disk in GB.

parameters.name: data_disk_gb
parameters.description: Size of the data disk in GB. Set to 0 to skip data disk creation.

parameters.name: checkpoint_name
parameters.description: Name of the pre-CIS hardening checkpoint to create.

playbook_output.description: Emits new_vm_name, new_vm_ext_id, checkpoint_name, checkpoint_ext_id, and provisioning_evidence.

fields.name: new_vm_name
fields.description: Name of the newly provisioned VM.

fields.name: new_vm_ext_id
fields.description: External ID of the newly provisioned VM.

fields.name: checkpoint_name
fields.description: Name of the pre-CIS hardening checkpoint.

fields.name: checkpoint_ext_id
fields.description: External ID of the created checkpoint.

steps.name: Resolve template VM name to ext_id
steps.function: Look up the template VM by name to obtain its external ID.

steps.name: Extract template VM ext_id
steps.function: Extract the external ID of the template VM from the lookup result.

computations._template_vm_ext_id: Extract the ext_id of the first matching VM from _template_vm_lookup.

steps.name: Does the template VM exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the template VM lookup found a matching VM.
steps.condition: The template VM lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Resolve provisioning port group name to subnet ext_id
steps.function: Look up the temporary provisioning port group (subnet) by name to obtain its external ID.

steps.name: Does the provisioning port group exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the subnet lookup found a matching port group.
steps.condition: The provisioning port group lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Extract subnet ext_id
steps.function: Extract the external ID of the provisioning subnet from the lookup result.

computations._subnet_ext_id: Extract the ext_id of the first matching subnet from _subnet_lookup.

steps.name: Clone template VM with CPU/RAM/NIC/guest customization
steps.function: Clone the pre-hardened template VM, configure CPU/RAM, attach one vNIC to the provisioning port group, and stage guest customization with DHCP and hostname.

steps.name: Is the selected OS family Windows?
steps.function: Branch on the selected OS family to choose the correct initialization path.
steps.condition: The selected OS family is Windows.

steps.name: Create OS and data disk layout
steps.function: Create the OS disk and optional data disk layout on the cloned VM.

steps.name: Initialize Windows Server 2025 (Unattend/NGT Tools)
steps.function: Initialize the Windows Server 2025 guest using Unattend and Nutanix Guest Tools.

steps.name: Is the selected OS family RHEL?
steps.function: Branch on the selected OS family to choose the RHEL initialization path.
steps.condition: The selected OS family is RHEL.

steps.name: Initialize RHEL 10 (Cloud-init/NGT Tools)
steps.function: Initialize the RHEL 10 guest using Cloud-init and Nutanix Guest Tools.

steps.name: Create pre-CIS hardening checkpoint
steps.function: Create a Nutanix checkpoint (snapshot) of the VM before CIS hardening.

steps.name: Capture provisioning evidence
steps.function: Assemble a provisioning evidence summary from the VM and checkpoint results.

computations._provisioning_evidence: Build a summary string containing the new VM name, VM ext_id, checkpoint name, and checkpoint ext_id.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Resolve template VM and provisioning port group names to external IDs and validate they exist.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Clone the template VM with CPU/RAM/NIC/guest customization and create the disk layout.

phases.name: OS initialization
phases.description: Initialize the guest OS based on the selected OS family (Windows or RHEL).

phases.name: Snapshot and evidence
phases.description: Create the pre-CIS hardening checkpoint and capture provisioning evidence.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
